rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Lion-headed armed soldier riding pale horse.

visual_requirements.description: One lion-headed humanoid armed soldier on pale horse.
High towers/castle from his documented office; no magical construction effect inferred.

aura: Ancaman melalui kepala singa prajurit berkuda pucat yang menerjang (sabnak-c03, sabnak-c05), tanpa aura generik.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
Spear, shield and armor material are editorial choices within armed soldier description. No claim of instant magical construction or invented spell effects.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of SABNOCK, the lion-headed armed soldier and mighty marquis.
ANATOMY: ONE lion head with mane atop fully armored HUMAN soldier torso, two human arms and two human legs; carrying an iron spear and round shield as editorial arms; mounted on ONE pale-coloured horse with one head, four legs [sabnak-c03,c05].
MOMENT: charging directly toward viewer through a castle gate, lion mouth roaring, shield thrust forward, spear angled upward; pale horse surges through dust.
POWER: no magical beams or invented effects. His high towers and castle stand physically behind him [sabnak-c04,c06]; no wounds or gore portrayed.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, rider's lion head and armored shoulders dominate upper frame, horse head and forelegs visible lower frame, no invented gigantic size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm sunset side light at castle gate, strong rim light, deep shadows and dust kicked by horse.
SURFACE: matted lion mane, scratched iron armor, coarse pale horse coat, weathered castle stone.
SETTING: castle gate and high towers, documented builder of fortifications [sabnak-c04,c06].
MOOD: dangerous original lion-headed demonic warrior, active confrontation.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

visual_review.notes: Lion head human armored rider, two arms, spear/shield; pale horse charging, two forelegs distinct, hindquarters occluded naturally. Subject dominates, no ungrounded power effect. Native and 200px inspected.
